headline: What The Bipolar Silicon Market Structure Means Moving Forward: Nividia Vs. Broadcom
summary: NVIDIA and Broadcom just reported back-to-back blowout quarters selling to the same hyperscale customers with opposite strategies, and the gap between their stock reactions tells you something important about where AI infrastructure spending goes next.
